Union census counts a picture once if any annotation file marks it, duplicate copies removed. Resolved keeps one annotation of record per picture. The analysed set is that resolution over every picture in an annotation. The split set is the part that can enter the split.

26 annotation entries, all in the older library file, could not be matched to a picture row, so the union column can read one or two below the resolved column. The resolved and analysed columns are the counts of record.

The split set for the four object classes holds the pictures carrying the size flag, because the split treats the flag as the positive for those classes. The training label list carries 32 pictures in the Fiber flag that the annotation records as Extraneous Polymer.

name: Definitions
rows: Every distinct image in the library, counted once.
The 6,938 pictures that carry an annotation entry.
One class present on a picture: an object class, a whole-image tag, or Clear.
The class of a marked object: Bubble, Bubble Cluster, Wet Package, Foreign Matter, Fiber, Extraneous Polymer, HEMA.
One tag on the picture, not on an object.
The micron threshold tag on an object. It marks an object over the size threshold and sits inside its class; it is not a label.
A picture with nothing marked. It counts as one label.
The four object classes together: Foreign Matter, Fiber, Extraneous Polymer, HEMA. A group, not a class in the guide.
A picture counted once if any annotation file marks it, duplicate copies removed.
One annotation of record per picture; older annotations of the same picture ignored.
